title: Pos XY export document, version 1
description: Plaintext of a .json export, and of a .pxy file after decryption and decompression. See docs/FORMAT.md.

exportedAt.description: Unix time (seconds) when the file was written.

t.description: Unix time in seconds (UTC), fractional allowed.

alt.description: Altitude above mean sea level, metres.

crs.description: Course over ground, degrees clockwise from true north.

act.description: Activity reported by the device. Known values: stationary, walking, running, cycling, driving, flying, unknown. Readers map anything else to unknown.
